mapper.select: SELECT a.platform_id, a.platform_name, a.platform_code, a.platform_desc, a.platform_icon, a.publish_key, a.auth_config_json, a.auth_ext_func_id, b.func_name AS auth_ext_func_name, a.tenant_id, a.status_cd, a.creator_id, a.created_time, a.updator_id, a.updated_time, a.remark FROM bt_a2a_platform a LEFT JOIN bt_skill_function b ON b.func_id = a.auth_ext_func_id AND b.tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.platform_id = #{platformId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_a2a_platform ( platform_id, platform_name, platform_code, platform_desc, platform_icon, publish_key, auth_config_json, auth_ext_func_id, tenant_id, status_cd, creator_id, created_time, updator_id, updated_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{dto.platformId}, #{dto.platformName}, #{dto.platformCode}, #{dto.platformDesc}, #{dto.platformIcon}, #{dto.publishKey}, #{dto.authConfigJson}, #{dto.authExtFuncId}, #{dto.tenantId}, #{dto.statusCd}, #{dto.creatorId}, , #{dto.updatorId}, , #{dto.remark} )
mapper.update:
